chunks: And by this chain, Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah said: Abu 'Amran al-Armani narrated to me from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah al-Bata'ini from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala' who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
If all who are on the earth denied Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), Allah would punish them all and enter them into the Fire.

key_terms.عَ: Abbreviation for 'Alayhi al-Salam (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of denying Amir al-Mu'minin according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) emphasizes the cosmic weight of denying Imam Ali’s (a.s.) Wilayah, asserting that universal denial by all inhabitants of the earth would result in collective punishment and entry into Hellfire. This underscores the Shia doctrine that Imam Ali is the foundational pillar of faith, where his recognition is inextricably linked to divine acceptance, and his denial constitutes a comprehensive rejection of prophetic authority.
